title: An Adventure for Two
description: An Adventure For Two is a cooperative mod meant to be played by exactly two players. Progress, experience, and survival are shared, and the world reacts when one player is missing, pushing teamwork and connection
body:
![Adventure for two](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/800d66a9c6584b1b3fb4fca87e0074179dacb15e.png)

An Adventure For Two is a cooperative Minecraft mod designed to be experienced by exactly two players. It is not just recommended — it is fundamental. The world, its rules, and its progression are built around the bond between two adventurers.

This mod makes players share key mechanics such as experience and progression, encouraging constant cooperation and mutual survival. When one player falls, the other must endure alone, creating tense moments where teamwork truly matters. If one player is missing, the world reacts, limiting progression and reminding that this journey is meant to be shared.

The relationship between the two players is intentionally left open and inclusive. Whether you play as friends, partners, or companions, the modpack adapts without forcing labels, allowing everyone to enjoy the experience regardless of orientation, identity, or background.

Core systems are shared: experience, progression, and survival. When one player falls, the other must endure alone, turning every mistake into real pressure. If one player is missing, the world responds by limiting progress and reminding you that this journey is meant to be shared.

This is not a race, nor a solo challenge. Adventure For Two is about trust, synchronization, and facing the unknown together. Every victory is shared, every mistake has consequences, and every step forward only truly matters when taken side by side.
